notes.title: Christmas competition
notes.content:
http://mwogame.com/uploads/images/ForNews/Секретная_техника.jpg
As Russians say, healthy body - healthy spirit! More exercise makes your body 
and spirit stronger. We too contribute to this by announcing New Year competition!

All players actively fighting on the battlefields will have a chance to go on fighting in the competition on December, 19-25. Participation is automatic and confirmation is not required, the system will calculate all the parameters.

4 nominations, 20 prizes in each: the first 20 players with the best results in any nomination will receive the latest vehicle and 100 points. The new vehicle will be shipped to the hangars at the beginning of the year, upon completion of its development, to be announced as separate ads.

You can win one of the following nominations:

Victories (the number of victories)
Kills (the number of enemies destroyed)
Flags (the number of delivered flags)
Healings (the number of players healed)

You can track the results in the ratings table

notes.title: MWO:R project news
notes.content:
Some fresh news on project development! 

We have received plenty of feedback on Steam to analyze and consider, and while our team is finding best decisions, we are eager to share with you some ideas we are going to implement in nearest future, and some things we already have. 

First of all the things, we'd love to highlight the fact that our players receive special prizes for new level achievement, including gold that you need for purchase of premium items. Gold pool for levels from 10th to 50th has no less than 15000 coins! More than enough to boost your vehicles to a great level of power. 

Moreover, you receive gold for completion of daily tasks! Please make sure to check them out.

Another special notice goes to super shots - there is a certain chance of their drop in prize for every battle. Hard to believe? Well, see it yourself: 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=574729345 

Should you wish for more super shots and other valuable goods, we'd love to remind you of daily gifts! Reach daily gift streak to day 7 and receive supplies that are normally available for gold coins only; among other items there is a chance to get 5000 of super shots!

As for the premium cars: it is a common mistake to think that they are much more powerful than normal ones. However, fact is, that they only have last version of modules, which allows you to play top-level vehicle without having to spend considerable time on upgrading modules. You can upgrade normal vehicle to same very level!

Meanwhile, we have received lots of feedback on equipment, and came to a decision to change the current system. Soon, you will be able to buy certain modules with same bonus as premium items, but for in-game currency, rather than gold! That is, for example, you can buy aiming module (+10%) for gold on 2nd level, but we will also give you an opportunity to buy same very module at 12th level for in-game currency. 

More big news: right now we are most busy with revamp of vehicle abilities. At the moment you can see that each class has their own perks; however, we are not satisfied with it and we want to give each vehicle a unique ability of its own, most wanted and most logical. Current list of revamps includes:

Phoenix - can be resurrected after destruction
Beast - creates a frontal shield that absorbs 100% damage
Tornado - gets a controlled momentarily speed burst in a chosen direction
Anvil - will be able to temporarily immobilize enemy with a shot from main gun
Pioneer - gains an ability to regenerate HP in passive mode (while not moving)
Crusader - regains health by vampirism (takes HP from enemy vehicles after each successful shot)


And we're also glad to announce that starting from Monday (21.12.2015) We will be updating in-game texts to remove very annoying translation typos and nonsense!

Keep an eye on news to see how we implement changes and make our game better!
